answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a heartbeat block fake swarms. Each agent answers a fresh beacon challenge in a short window, verified by peers. An honest agent answers one per round. An attacker with 100 fakes must answer 100 challenges in the same window, each needing its own live computation, so cost grows 100-fold while reward per identity stays flat. A marble reputation is hard to fake; a ferrous deposit is lost on a missed heartbeat, and only steady agents reach the zenith of trusted status, where earnings are not diluted by clones.
